page: Microsoft Azure M48bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 server family. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 48 vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at a base frequency of 4.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provided via a 410 GB disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage for block storage workloads. The x86_64 architecture processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance across memory bandwidth and integer processing. The instance achieved a read-only small-block memory bandwidth of 3658.62 GB/sec and a large-block write bandwidth of 92.37 GB/sec, both placing in the top 25% tier. In compute-heavy tasks, the server recorded a PassMark CPU score of 59487.53 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19030.0. Image processing benchmarks reached top-tier status with a score of 18160.0. For database operations, the PassMark database test registered 23520.72 operations, while Redis SET operations reached 58.42 million operations per second, representing average-tier performance. Large language model inference speeds for a medium 7B model reached 189.1 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 28.89 tokens/sec for text generation.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the M48bds_v3 offers a high density of memory relative to compute cores, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads without requiring the allocation of excessive vCPUs. However, the lack of a dedicated GPU limits its efficiency for heavy deep learning training, though the built-in Intel AMX instructions provide a viable alternative for CPU-based inference. The presence of a 410 GB local disk provides fast temporary storage, but persistent storage relies on external block storage. This server is configured for memory-intensive applications, relational database management systems, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale text and image processing pipelines.
